decisions.reason: Using the client's manufacturing account to add boards does not change the required contents of the power-board production package.
The account-access and cart-setup decision does not alter the required sensor-board BOM or manufacturing exports.
Adding boards through the client's account does not change the separate obligation to review component orientations in the manufacturing platform.
The manufacturing-account access method does not change component availability or sourceability requirements.
The decision about account access and adding boards does not change board identification or connector-pin marking requirements.
Manufacturing-account and cart setup does not modify the main board's mechanical layout.
The account-access decision does not affect ESP32 pin coverage, breakout technology, or module pin count.
The manufacturing-account setup method does not alter the main-board power-source OR-ing behavior.
The account-access decision does not change the battery temperature-sensing method.
Adding boards to the client's manufacturing account does not modify the power board's mechanical or connector layout.
The manufacturing-account setup decision does not change the sensor board's mechanical layout or component-placement constraints.
The account setup destination and access method have no effect on the main-board GPIO assignments.
